verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Fathom offers flexible capture options (bot vs bot-free) and unlimited meeting capture/summaries, which speaks to the 'recording where I want it' aspect, but none of the docs explicitly confirm reliable capture across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams specifically, nor any hands-on reliability corroboration. missing for 10: explicit platform coverage (Zoom/Meet/Teams) confirmation, independent reliability evidence, details on how bot-free capture technically works across platforms.
